optimizedDescription.value: Reusable synchronous YAML/Zod structural parser returns typed raw schema data; callers own semantic validation and domain construction.

optimizedContext.value:
# Parse Schema YAML
## Rules
- Export parseSchemaYaml(ref: string, yamlContent: string): SchemaYamlData from infrastructure/schema-yaml-parser.ts; ref only identifies errors.
- Export Zod-inferred SchemaYamlData, ArtifactYaml, WorkflowStepRaw raw shapes with optional undefined; never domain entities.
- Parse yaml; null/non-object/array throws SchemaValidationError with ref and YAML mapping message.
- Validate SchemaYaml: name/version/kind/artifacts; schema-only extends; artifact fields; ids for hooks/rules/cleanup/extractors; workflow/metadataExtraction; strip unknown top fields. Reuse SelectorZodSchema/SelectorRaw.
- Refinements: deltaValidations needs delta; delta forbidden change scope; schema-plugin forbids artifacts/workflow/metadataExtraction/extends.
- Failure throws first SchemaValidationError issue with ref + exported formatZodPath dot-bracket path.
- Never check duplicates, ID format, requires validity/cycles, optional deps; never construct Schema/ArtifactType/WorkflowStep/Selector.
## Constraints
- Infrastructure not fs; yaml/zod dependencies; SchemaValidationError sole domain import; synchronous strip mode.
